name: catalog-smoke-retired-consistency
title: Fix command-catalog-smoke to respect retired dispatch agents via bidirectional consistency
description: command-catalog-smoke.ts fails on clean main because it iterates the full AGENT_DISPATCH_REGISTRY (including the deliberately-retired lattice-review-channel) and asserts every canonicalName must be schema-valid and satisfy the runtime dispatch contract. The command catalog is already correct (dispatch.agentType derives from AGENT_DISPATCH_ACCEPTED_TYPES, which filters out the retired lane). The smoke guard itself has the defect. Fix the guard to assert bidirectional consistency and wire it into validate.commands.
